[ 02 ] OUR STORY

Independent thinking.
Shared purpose.

SpaceKaur is building autonomous systems for space and aerospace applications.

Incubated at IIT Madras, we bring together a team rooted in aerospace engineering and an approach grounded in physics, testing and evidence.

Our focus spans the models, control systems, software and hardware that make autonomy possible.
